evidence.quote: UCD-LLM’s performance depends on the quality of the underlying pre-trained LLM. For example, among three model variants, 𝑈𝐶𝐷-𝐿𝐿𝑀𝐷𝑒𝑒𝑝𝑆𝑒𝑒𝑘 — despite having the most parameters — performs the worst, likely because it is trained mostly on general data. Weaknesses in the base model can affect UCD-LLM’s overall results and reliability.
In the use case relationship extraction module, UCD-LLM checks relationships between all use case pairs. If a debate is triggered, it requires more computation.
Though the debate mechanism adds some computational cost, it helps resolve ambiguities early and reduces the need for later corrections.
